user.title: Add Truma iNet X
user.description: Select the Truma panel to add.

confirm.description: Do you want to add the Truma panel {name}?

pair.title: Pair with the Truma panel
pair.description:
Put the panel {name} into add-device mode (in the Truma InetX app, or on the panel itself), then select **Submit**. Pairing can take up to a minute.

If it fails, clear the panel's saved Bluetooth device list — its bond storage may be full — and try again. If you are **re-pairing** through a Bluetooth proxy (ESP32), also clear the proxy's stored bonds (press its **Clear BLE bonds** button), otherwise the panel rejects the new bond.

error.pairing_failed: Could not pair with the panel. Make sure it is in add-device mode and its Bluetooth device list has free slots. If you are re-pairing through a Bluetooth proxy, also clear the proxy's stored bonds (its **Clear BLE bonds** button), then try again.

abort.no_devices_found: No Truma iNet X panels found. Make sure the panel is powered on and in Bluetooth range.
abort.already_configured: This Truma panel is already configured.
abort.awaiting_name: Waiting for the Truma panel to advertise its name before pairing.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Re-paired with the Truma panel successfully.

control_not_ready.message: Truma BLE control is not available yet (transport is wired in a later build stage).
